recipes.name: Mom's Baked Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed Cheddar cheese soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.
Place macaroni in a 2-quart casserole dish. Stir in cheese soup and milk until well combined. Sprinkle with shredded Colby cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown and the casserole is bubbly, 25 to 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Mom's Baked Macaroni and Cheese
raw_recipe.description: This easy baked macaroni and cheese recipe uses Colby cheese and condensed cheese soup for a creamy, comforting casserole in under an hour.

review.reviewBody: Woweeeee! This Mac & Cheese is everything I wanted. Cheesy, creamy and gooey. Per other reviews I used 2 cans of soup, 1 1/2 cups milk and 1/2 cup of sour cream. I heated the milk and added everything (including most of the cheese)to the noodles after draining them and they blended perfectly. Put the rest of the cheese on top and sprinkled with paprika. Don't forget to salt the water when you boil your noodles or they will be flavorless. No leftovers here! P.S. I used sharp cheddar.

Usually make mac & cheese from scratch. This was much faster and easier! I added extra liquid after reading other reviews and checking the consistency as I assembled the dish. 
Cooked the macaroni, saved 1 cup pasta water and drained. Put the cheese soup and 1 1/4 cup milk in the same pot, cooked on med low, stirred until smooth. Then added 12 ounces of medium cheddar and the cup of pasta water, stirred until smooth. Then put the macaroni back in the pot and mixed well. Put into a 9 x 12 baking pan, spinkled the remaining cheese and some bread crumbs, baked as directed. Creamy and good!

5 stars after I followed some advice from another review. *Doubled the soup. *Used sharp cheddar cheese. *Added 1/2 cup of sour cream. * Changed to 1 1/2 cups milk. *Held back some of the cheese to top the casserole later.* Cooked about 15 minutes longer. *Then put the remaining cheese on top and sprinkled a little paprika over it. *Cooked until bubbly.

I made this last night with some tweaks to the recipe and got rave reviews. I did the changes others suggested--using 2 cans of soup, 1 1/2 cups of whole milk, and 1/2 cup of sour cream. I also used Sharp Cheddar cheese. I heated the soup, milk, and sour cream until it boiled, then I poured it over the warm, drained macaroni, stirring together. I put most of the cheese in the casserole itself, reserving 1 cup to sprinkle on the top. Then I took 1 cup of Panko breadcrumbs and mixed it with 2 tablespoons of melted butter and sprinkled that on the very top of the casserole. I baked it at 400 degrees for 20 minutes to get the top golden brown and crunchy. It was easy to make and had a big payoff--I'll definitely make this again!

I usually cook for family and church gatherings, using disposable aluminum table pans. This is a great recipe for that! I use 24 to 32 ounces of macaroni, cooked in salted water. I mix the grated cheese (2 1/2 cups), milk (1cup),sour cream (1 cup), and cheddar cheese soup (2 cans) in a large bowl. I then fold in the cooked macaroni, thoroughly mixing.

This was my first time making macaroni and cheese that wasn’t out of a kraft box so I wanted a recipe that was simple, easy to make and absolutely delicious, and this recipe fit the bill! I followed some of the suggestions I read in the reviews...used 2 cans of cheese soup, 1.5 cups milk, and 1/2 cup of sour cream...and voila it turned out perfect and was super scrumptious!! Will definitely be cooking this recipe again in the future! Only other things I would like to add is I did mix half of the Colby shredded cheese into the noodle mixture and then sprinkled the other half on top, and I had to bake mine for about 10ish close to 15 minutes longer than what the recipe suggested in order for it to brown in top. Again love love love easy, cheesy, and yummy!!!

I used one and a half boxes elbows. I added salt, paprika, pepper, onion powder(little bit), garlic powder(little bit) to the water. I also mixed two cups cheddar jack shredded cheese , one and a half cups milk, half cup sour cream, two cans cheddar soup al together before putting in dish, added some extra cheese on top. Baked for 20 minutes. Thank you to all the reviews for helping with some changes. Would make again.

I recently made this twice. The first time I made it as is, but to me it wasn’t flavorful. Still the basic aspect was good. So I took some of the reviewer’s suggestions as well as added a few of my own and the result was phenomenal. I added ½ cup of sour cream, a second can of the cheese soup, a half cup more of milk, salt and pepper to taste and about a half cup more shredded sharp cheddar cheese. I think the flavor of the Colby isn’t strong enough for this recipe. I also made a topping out of ½ cup Italian bread crumbs, a dash of paprika and ½ cup grated parmesan cheese. Mix and sprinkle on top. Melt 3 tablespoons of butter and pour over the top and put in the oven.

I used two cans of cheddar cheese soup, 1 1/2 cups of milk, 1/2 cup of sour cream, and added garlic powder, minced onion, and generous salt and pepper and it was great. First time I made it, I followed the recipe and found it to be dry, and very bland. Also mixed most of shredded cheese into it before baking, put a think layer on top. Then topped with fried onions....Excellent!

I've made this several times over the last couple of years and I use a small container of cream in addition to the milk, as well as a 1 lb, brick of SHARP cheddar in addition to the Colby cheese, and finally 2 cans of cheddar cheese soup. SO much creamier!!

The mac and cheese turned out well and was a hit with my son. Since I did not have any cheddar soup on hand, I substituted 1 lb of cubed Velveta, melted in the microwave with the milk and butter, for the cheddar soup. Next time I will add onions and maybe some garlic to the recipe to spice it up a bit.
I added different cheeses with the cheddar like mozzarella and Swiss and parmesan. Someone else said nacho cheese was good too. I've doubled the recipe for a large crowd.
Yummy

So easy and a lot cheaper to make than all of the different cheeses I normally use! But it still tastes great! Kids really love it! I sprinkle buttery toasted bread crumbs on top for a little crunch. Yummy
Yes I tweaked it a little, was great!
I used cheddar cheese instead. Colby is bland. Turned out perfect. Seasoned bread crumbs on top.
FAST & EASY! VERY GOOD!
This recipe is so easy - I love easy. I changed nothing in the recipe and the best part is that everyone always likes it. Everyone! Husband and grandchildren. It’s a hit. Thanks for this.
I made this but added, Sharp Chedder, Chedder, Swiss and Mozella cheese.
It was good!! I added Velveeta to mine.
